The group provides its size to the controls inside.

keyboard.action: Moves through the controls and any button addon in order; the group itself is not a tab stop and addon text is never focusable.

form.notes: The group has no value: the controls inside are the form participants and submit themselves. It observes their displayed invalidity (observeControl) to colour the addon borders.

differences.text: One focus ring around the whole group. The group tracks keyboard focus inside itself and draws the ring; the controls inside drop their own ring and square their inner corners. A light-DOM sheet (`tct-input-group.light.css`, adopted into the tree that contains the group) reaches each control's `part="input"`, so any control that names its painted box `input` joins the group.

The group's inherited private properties (`--_group-border-color`, `--_group-margin-start`, `--_group-radius-*`) style the addons across the shadow boundary; the member overlap is a margin on each member's painted box because an application reset (`* { margin: 0 }`) beats `::slotted()`.
Status is also shown on the addon borders, and a control that displays invalidity colours them too (observeControl). Upstream only passes the status to the theme.

The group's outer corners are the 4px element radius; the addon cell is the muted surface with the Tecton outlined-input border (`--tecton-color-input-outlined-border`), so it reads as the same edge as the field next to it.

core.input-group.notes: Guides: [mwg:styling-web-components] custom properties cross the boundary, `::part` from the outer tree, `::slotted` loses to light-DOM resets; [mwg:accessible-web-components] the group role and its label live in one shadow root; [mwg:child-state-based-styling] the group follows the focus inside it.
